summary: Lake County, OR: CCC-built 54-foot timber lookout completed in 1938, manned at least through 1979; pulled down and burned in 1984 (register says 1988).

facts.design: 54-foot timber tower with 14x14 house (1959 inspection); register calls it a 54-foot wooden L-4 tower
facts.status_note: Tower pulled down and burned by a fire crew in 1984 (Forest Lookouts) or 1988 (register)
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Fremont National Forest

visit.trail_note: No tower remains to climb; a 1983 report found the stairs unsafe

events.note: Side camp building a road and telephone line to the summit; crew said the road could reach within a quarter mile of the top by October
Firelookout.com lists a 119-foot L-6 tower; the Forest Lookouts sources read do not mention one
Lookout tower completed October 10 by CCC men from the Bly camp; cost $2,546.14
Lightning fire of 250 to 300 acres east of Bly spotted from the Fishhole lookout
David Marshall was moving to Fishhole with an FM radio (July 1947); Roy Laird took over that September
Francis E. Alvord at Fishhole since 1964 (1979 profile)
Lost Fire burned the Fishhole Guard Station; a fire lookout post had to be abandoned
Bly District Ranger requested a structural survey; stairs and deck found unsafe
Fire crew pulled the tower down with a small Cat and burned the remains; register gives 1988
Registered May 20, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: The register gives the tower as 54 feet and the 1959 inspection says 54 feet in height; 21.0 m is about 69 feet

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts: CCC completed the tower October 10, 1938; register: built by the CCC in 1939; 1959 inspection: constructed in 1940. The story gives the 1938 completion and reports the other two dates.

Removal is dated 1984 (Forest Lookouts), 1988 (register), and a 1977 burning (Firelookout.com). The 1977 fire burned the guard station, and a 1979 profile describes a manned tower, so the 1977 claim is not supported. The story reports 1984 and 1988 as disputed.

notes_for_editor: Build year disputed (1938, 1939, 1940). Removal year disputed (1984, 1988, and 1977 per Firelookout.com, unsupported by the 1979 profile). Firelookout.com alone lists a 1934 119-foot L-6 tower, not mentioned in the Forest Lookouts page; left out of the story body except as a disputed sentence. No source describes the summit today. The 1979 profile gives Alvord on the forest since 1951 and at Fishhole since 1964; both are stated. The 1973 closure plan is in the story but no closure event is recorded, because the 1979 profile shows the lookout still staffed. Height record corrected from 21.0 m to 16.5 m (54 ft).
